xmldoc.short_description: Create durations from years or convert durations to years.

param_input_item.param_description: Numeric year counts or duration arrays.

param_output_item.param_description: A duration array for numeric input, or double year counts for duration input.

description.p: Create durations from years or convert durations to years.
A year is treated as 365.2425 days for elapsed-time duration conversion. For calendar-year arithmetic, use calyears.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
